protocol.load_scope: strict load_state_dict of an already resident immutable clone including hooks and sealing, without disk IO or checkpoint construction
protocol.prepare_scope: complete FrozenFinancialConsumer.prepare and completion synchronization from the same initial state
protocol.total_scope: whole worker including imports, source archive, fixtures, validation, warmups and measurements
protocol.timing: perf_counter_ns with cuda synchronization immediately before start and before stop
protocol.percentiles: linear interpolation, descriptive only for ten samples
protocol.memory: process RSS and Torch allocator, neither exclusive variant memory nor total physical process VRAM
protocol.memory_peak_reset: each warmup and sample after synchronization, before timing
protocol.processes: one independent process per --repository and --label, invoked by existing run-check.py

limits: Procesos separados y cargas concurrentes no controladas. No se atribuye aceleración al cambio.
Los percentiles de diez muestras son descriptivos.
RSS y asignador Torch no representan memoria exclusiva de cada variante.
La referencia restaura dos fuentes a bbb2b51. No es un checkout íntegro de ese commit.
